attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for working cooperatively with other governments and through the United Nations to solve global problems.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for demilitarizing the border and ending all immigrant detention in the US.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for granting immediate and unconditional Amnesty for all immigrants, regardless of current immigration status.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for ending the Global War on Terror, including repealing the Authorization for Use of Military Force (AUMF), closing the Guantanamo Bay prison camp, withdrawing US troops from the Middle East and Africa, and ending extrajudicial executions (“drone strikes”), airstrikes, torture, and detention.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to using economic and financial sanctions to punish other countries, such as Cuba, Venezuela, and Iran, that dare to act independently of the United States.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to all broad-based sanctions that are designed to punish entire populations, violently coerce foreign governments, and instigate regime change.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Support for rewriting the rules of trade, embodied in bilateral and multilateral trade and investment agreements like NAFTA, to strengthen rather than erode environmental protections, the power of labor, and the ability of Global South nations to chart their own development paths.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Support for abolishing USAID, NED, Voice of America, and other governmental agencies that cynically disguise capitalist control as aid and journalism.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
